page.content:
Whip-tailed Morrison sauropod with a long, low skull.

How Diplodocus connects

  • Topic: Sauropoda — Diplodocus is a slender Morrison sauropod.
  • Location: Morrison Formation — Diplodocus is a classic Morrison sauropod.

What is Diplodocus?

Diplodocus is the slender sauropod whose mounted skeletons defined public sauropods for a century, a Morrison genus of riverine floodplains.

Key threads lead to Sauropoda and Morrison Formation.
